Surya Local OCR Check

Synthetic research document · SwiftStudy

Abstract

This document verifies local document recognition on a Mac. The application renders a PDF page and sends the image to an embedded model. No document is uploaded to an external service.

Method

The pipeline uses PDFKit, llama.cpp, and Surya. It preserves text blocks and their positions so the original page can be checked alongside the extracted text.

Result

Verification code: SURYA-2026. The expected value is 42. This synthetic example makes no scientific claims.
